rows.grounds: past passive participle of saṃ-sthā, 'having established'
dikpāla = direction-guardian; dative plural 'to the direction-guardians'
third person singular active present of hu, 'offers'

items.question: What offering is made to the direction-guardians after the deities are established?
premises: Deities are established at the doors.
items.inference: After establishing the deities, one offers to the direction-guardians.
uncertainties: The exact offering substance is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having established them, he offers to the direction-guardians, and continues the rite.
